node.title: Re: Use of uninitialized value $i in bitwise and (&) at <Netmask.pm>
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Looking at the [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Net-Netmask+1.9022|CPAN Testers Matrix] and some specific test results for [dist://Net-Netmask] is worrying to me: the operations the module is performing should be deterministic, but at least on Linux some tests are failing sometimes*, so I'm not really sure if this module is reliable. I'm not up-to-date on the best modules for this kind of task, so perhaps another monk will be able to recommend something.

* Update: I would guess it has to do with the options Perl was built with, a quick sampling of some failing vs. passing configurations shows that the failing ones have, among other things, USE_LONG_DOUBLE set, as also reported in [https://rt.cpan.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=99184|#99184]. OTOH, even older versions, like the one you've linked to, [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Net-Netmask%201.9015|show] some test failures.
